text:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up — VeloxPay onboarding: noticed steady p95 latency creep over last 48h and token burn higher than expected. Renewal conversation scheduled ~3 weeks out, so this is a bit time-sensitive :face_with_raised_eyebrow:

maria_cs: Thinking we should propose a short plan: (1) try int8 quant profile on their 3B model, (2) fallback model swap for tail requests, (3) route interactive sessions to Dedicated pool during peak. Can we triage numbers? :spiral_calendar:

alex_se: can you paste the perf snapshot? p50/p95/p99, tokens per call, error spikes?

maria_cs: yes — quick dump below, pulled from console at 08:12 UTC:

```
account: VeloxPay
window: last 48h
requests: 12.4k
avg tokens per request: 820
cost estimate/day: $1.6k
latency p50: 140ms
latency p95: 980ms
latency p99: 2.1s
5xx rate: 0.9% (spikes to 2.4% during 17:00-19:00 UTC)
primary model: rw-compact-3b-v1
routing: hosted-default -> us-west-2
```

jordan_ml: rough thoughts — int8 quant (our int8q profile) on rw-compact-3b-v1 usually drops token CPU/GPU time ~25-35% and p95 by ~20-30ms for these seq lengths. quality regressions are small on our eval sets (~<2% delta on rouge/likelihood). Worth trying a quick local eval on their evaluation prompt set.

jordan_ml: alternative: stage rw-lite-2b as a low-latency fallback for prefix-heavy requests (same prompt but shorter context). Route <200-token requests to rw-lite-2b, long ones stay on compact-3b. That reduces tail latency and lowers cost.

alex_se: ok — do we have their eval prompt set captured? if not we should ask them. Also need to estimate cost delta. if int8 saves 30% and fallback reduces 20% of requests cost, that looks good.

maria_cs: they gave a small eval set during onboarding but didn't instrument model-level scoring. i'll pull it and share. planning to ask for a short permission to run a canary with quantized variant.

sam_platform: FYI on infra: Dedicated pool in us-west has capacity for an extra canary at p95 target. If we do quant canary, steps are: 1) create canary model variant (int8 profile) 2) set traffic split 5% for 24h 3) capture quality metrics + latency + cost delta 4) escalate to 25%/stable if no regressions. I can provision the canary and add automatic rollback on quality regression.

sam_platform: also recommend routing policy: tag interactive sessions from VeloxPay (customer_id) and route to Dedicated during their business hours; off-hours route to hosted cheaper pool. That should keep UX stable while saving cost.

maria_cs: perfect. i'll coordinate a customer-facing enablement session to get eval permission and explain canary. Proposed timeline: kick canary this Friday, measure over weekend, decision next Monday. Renewal touchpoint Tue. Thoughts?

alex_se: timeline sounds tight but doable. can we add an engineering shadow during rollout window (Fri evening)? i can do Fri 16:00-20:00 PST.

jordan_ml: i'll run quick offline eval on their prompts today and post a perf/quality delta. if int8 looks clean -> green light for canary.

maria_cs: i'll draft the customer note and include the A/B consent language + rollback plan. will ask them to share 100-200 gold prompts for quality check.

deploy-bot: Canary created: canary-veloxpay-int8-1918002468 (traffic 5%) — metrics streaming to https://console.redwood/metrics/canary-veloxpay-int8-1918002468

maria_cs: awesome :raised_hands: I'll run the enablement call invite now and capture notes in the playbook. Action owners: maria_cs -> customer enablement & consent; sam_platform -> canary provisioning + rollback; jordan_ml -> eval runs; alex_se -> on-call for rollout.

alex_se: noted. i'll also prepare a quick runbook snippet for the CSM showing "what to expect" during canary.

maria_cs: thanks team. i'll update thread with customer reply and the initial canary metrics once they land.

sam_platform: ping me if we need to increase canary traffic or run a manual rollback.

maria_cs: capturing feedback ask for the customer: 1) do you notice differences in output quality? 2) any latency differences? 3) are there specific prompts that degrade? we'll collect and map to eval results.

jordan_ml: if we see >3% quality drop on gold set we rollback immediately. otherwise proceed to staged ramp.

maria_cs: closing for now — thanks everyone :sparkles:
